title.zh: 【币安：已开始为用户恢复受影响资产，预留超 63.4 亿美元覆盖损失】
title.en: 【币安：已开始为用户恢复受影响资产，预留超 63.4 亿美元覆盖损失】

current_state.zh: Binance has begun restoring user assets hit by the theft, earmarking more than $6.34 billion of company funds — $5 billion already held in the affected tokens with the remainder being bought via market and OTC channels to match the stolen asset mix — while roughly $3 billion has been frozen with industry partners and final balances will be publicly verifiable through Proof of Reserves.
